name.en: Casa Norte H18-X 18-Volt Cordless Hammer Drill with Side Handle and 1/2-Inch Chuck
name.pt-BR: Furadeira de Impacto Casa Norte H18-X 18 V com Empunhadura Lateral e Mandril de 13 mm

description.en: A cordless hammer drill for brick, block, wood, and metal around renovation jobs. The auxiliary handle gives both hands control in masonry mode, while the 1/2-inch chuck takes larger bits.
description.pt-BR: Furadeira de impacto a bateria para tijolo, bloco, madeira e metal em reformas. A empunhadura auxiliar dá controle com as duas mãos no modo impacto, e o mandril de 13 mm recebe brocas maiores.
